Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a chemical cross-linking (CXMS) study using DSS. While not a traditional TPP (Thermal Proteome Profiling) assay, mod_tpp is often used in routing for structural/complex proteomics or specific CXMS workflows depending on the implementation; however, the primary signal is the use of DSS cross-linkers and xQuest for cross-link identification.

organism: Molecular architecture of the human tRNA ligase complex
scope: study two tRNA ligase complexes, one consisting of subunits RTCB, DDX1, CGI-99, FAM98B and Ashwin (“full tRLC”) and one lacking Ashwin (“core tRLC”)
